newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 4.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
A commentary accuses Australia of pandering to U.S. interests and warns that that coupled with anti-Asian sentiment could harm Canberra's ties with its Asian neighbours.
Economic tsar Zhu Rongji calls on state enterprises to boost their efficiency and says China's poverty-stricken areas should focus on meeting the basic necessities of residents.
Sales of colour televisions in September jumped by more than 34 percent compared to August while refrigerator sales slid nearly 11 percent in the month.
